function.name: corporate_finance_calculate_YOY_growth_rate
function.description: Calculate the year over year (YOY) growth rate for a company. Unlike financial_ratios_calculate_ROE, which uses net income and average shareholder equity, this uses revenue from an initial year and a subsequent year.

year1_revenue.description: The revenue for the initial year.

year2_revenue.description: The revenue for the subsequent year.

function.name: financial_ratios_calculate_ROE
function.description: Calculate the return on equity (ROE) for a company. Unlike financial_ratios_calculate_ROA, whose denominator is total average assets, this uses average shareholder equity as its denominator.

net_income.description: Net income for the period. This is a float type value.

shareholder_equity.description: Average shareholder equity for the period. This is a float type value.

function.name: financial_ratios_calculate_ROA
function.description: Calculate the return on assets (ROA) for a company. Unlike financial_ratios_calculate_ROE, whose denominator is average shareholder equity, this uses total average assets as its denominator.

net_income.description: Net income for the period. This is a float type value.

total_assets.description: Total average assets for the period. This is a float type value.
